d: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has renewed his criticism of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE), calling the agency cruel and saying it deserves to be abolished. Mamdani vowed to do everything within his power to protect immigrants in New York City, highlighting the contributions of more than three million immigrants to the city. Speaking about his own immigrant background, he said New York's identity and global standing were shaped by its immigrant communities.
